title: Mathematics
description: ISC Class XI Mathematics: one theory paper of 3 hours carrying 80 marks plus 20 marks project work. Three-dimensional geometry, calculus and statistics foundations begin here.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ISC Examination Year 2027 Regulations and Syllabuses - Mathematics (www.cisce.org), corroborated by Oswal Publishers' 2026-27 reproduction.
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026. Units: Sets and Functions; Algebra; Coordinate Geometry; Calculus; Statistics and Probability.

sections.title: Mathematics
sections.description: Five units from sets to probability.

chapters.title: Sets
chapters.blurb: Representations, subsets, Venn diagrams, operations and practical problems.

chapters.title: Relations and Functions
chapters.blurb: Ordered pairs, domain and range, types of relations and functions, graphs.

chapters.title: Trigonometric Functions
chapters.blurb: Radian measure, identities, compound and multiple angles, general solutions.

chapters.title: Complex Numbers
chapters.blurb: Argand plane, modulus and conjugate, polar form, square roots.

chapters.title: Quadratic Equations
chapters.blurb: Real and complex roots, discriminant analysis, nature of solutions.

chapters.title: Linear and Quadratic Inequalities
chapters.blurb: Solution of inequalities in one variable, graphical representation.

chapters.title: Permutations and Combinations
chapters.blurb: Factorial notation, fundamental counting principle, arrangements and selections.

chapters.title: Binomial Theorem
chapters.blurb: Expansion for positive integral index, general and middle terms.

chapters.title: Sequences and Series
chapters.blurb: AP, GP and their sums, AM-GM relationship, special series.

chapters.title: Straight Line
chapters.blurb: Slope, forms of equations, angle between lines, distance of a point from a line.

chapters.title: Circles
chapters.blurb: Standard and general equations, tangents and conditions.

chapters.title: Limits
chapters.blurb: Intuitive idea, algebra of limits, standard limits and trigonometric limits.

chapters.title: Derivatives
chapters.blurb: Derivative as rate of change, first principles, rules and standard results.

chapters.title: Statistics
chapters.blurb: Mean deviation, variance and standard deviation of grouped and ungrouped data.

chapters.title: Probability
chapters.blurb: Random experiments, events, axiomatic approach, addition theorem.
